```{r Setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(mapview)
library(readxl)

# Paden
path_percentielen1 <- "../../../../../Ecotoop/Getij/verwerking/Droogvalduur/outputDD/percentielen_OD_2017_2020.csv"
path_percentielen2 <- "../../../../../Ecotoop/Getij/verwerking/Droogvalduur/outputDD/percentielen_OD_ZR_2017_2020.csv"
path_percentielen3 <- "../../../../../Ecotoop/Getij/verwerking/Droogvalduur/outputDD/percentielen_OD_waterinfo_2017_2020.csv"

path_tijposten_csv <- "../../Data/Kalibratie/input/tijposten.csv"
path_tijposten_csv2 <- "../../Data/Kalibratie/input/extra_tijposten_Waterinfo.csv"

path_data <- "../../../../Aangeleverd/20260410_WL_DD_LW_HW/Statistics (overspoeling) 4QNplusQE.xlsx"

path_salzone_shp   <- "../../../../../GIS_Zeeschelde/Referentiedata/gebiedsindelingen/ScheldevalleiSalZone_KRW_OMES_2022.shp"
path_alloc_gdb     <- "../../../../../Ecotoop/Fysiotoop/BASIS_Ecotopen_GETIJ_ETRS.gdb"

# referentietijposten
path_ref_lw <- "../../Output/Kalibratie/01_LW_output_HIC_Scaldis_vergelijking.csv"

output_dir <- "../../Output/Kalibratie/"
output_fig <- "../../Output/Kalibratie/figuren_DD/"


```


```{r data WL inlezen + voorbereiden}
# inlezen data
data_long <- read_excel(path_data, sheet = 1) %>%
  rename(OD = 1) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ str_remove(str_remove(str_trim(.), "^WL "), " %$"))) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_remove(., "INBOpt_"), everything()) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(DD = (100 - OD)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(DD, OD), names_to = "AllocNR", values_to = "Value")

```


```{r HIC data inladen en preprocessing}
# 1. Meetdata inladen
df <- rbind(
  read.csv(path_percentielen1, sep=";"),
  read.csv(path_percentielen2, sep=";"),
  read.csv(path_percentielen3, sep=";")) %>%
  mutate(DD = 1 - percentiel) %>%
  distinct()

# 2. Locaties inladen en harmoniseren
tijpost_raw <- rbind(
  read.csv(path_tijposten_csv),
  read.csv2(path_tijposten_csv2)) %>%
  mutate(tijpost = if_else(tijpost == "Wintam Sluis", "Wintam Sluis Afwaarts", tijpost))

# 3. Ruimtelijke data inladen
sf_alloc <- st_read(dsn = path_alloc_gdb, layer = "AllocatieAspntScheldeRupelbekkenETRS") %>% select(AllocNR, Dist)
sf_salzone <- st_read(path_salzone_shp)

# 4. Join en Transformaties
sf_points <- tijpost_raw %>%
  inner_join(df, by = "tijpost") %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("x_lambert72", "y_lambert72"), crs = 31370) %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(sf_alloc)) %>%
  st_join(sf_alloc) %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(sf_salzone)) %>%
  st_join(sf_salzone) %>%
  rename(rivier = rivier.x) %>%
  select(-rivier.y)

```


```{r }
# 1. Opschonen en SalZone hernoemen
sf_data_clean <- sf_points %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(SalZone = case_when(
    SalZone %in% c("Zone met sterke saliniteitsgradiënt", "Mesohalien") ~ "brak",
    TRUE ~ "zoet"
  ))

# 2. Groeperen
df_summary <- sf_data_clean %>%
  group_by(tijpost, rivier, SalZone, AllocNR, DD, Dist) %>%
  summarise(
    waterstand_gem = mean(waterstand, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_jaren = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```


```{r Spatial Join: Allocatie-informatie}
# 1. Bereid de meetwaarden voor (HIC/Waterinfo data)
df_summary_prep <- sf_data_clean %>%
  group_by(tijpost, rivier, SalZone, AllocNR, DD, Dist) %>%
  summarise(
    waterstand_HIC = mean(waterstand, na.rm = TRUE), # Gemiddelde van de metingen
    n_jaren = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    AllocNR = as.character(AllocNR),
    DD_join = round(as.numeric(DD) * 100, 2) # Schaal 0-1 naar 0-100 voor de join
  )

# 2. Bereid de modelwaarden voor (WL data_long)
data_long_prep <- data_long %>%
  mutate(
    AllocNR = as.character(as.integer(AllocNR)),
    DD_join = round(as.numeric(DD), 2)) %>% # Stond al op schaal 0-100
  select(AllocNR, DD_join, waterstand_WL = Value) # Hernoem Value naar waterstand_WL

# 3. Voer de finale join uit
df_summary_final <- df_summary_prep %>%
  left_join(data_long_prep, by = c("AllocNR", "DD_join")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(waterstand_WL)) %>% # Behoud enkel de records met modeldata
  select(tijpost, rivier, SalZone, AllocNR, DD, Dist, 
         waterstand_HIC, waterstand_WL, n_jaren)


# 1. Maak een jaarlijkse samenvatting van de HIC data
df_yearly_prep <- sf_data_clean %>%
  # Zorg dat er een kolom 'jaar' beschikbaar is uit je brondata
  group_by(tijpost, rivier, SalZone, AllocNR, DD, Dist, jaar) %>%
  summarise(
    waterstand_HIC = mean(waterstand, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    AllocNR = as.character(AllocNR),
    DD_join = round(as.numeric(DD) * 100, 2))

# 2. Join met de modeldata (WL data_long_prep)
df_yearly_final <- df_yearly_prep %>%
  left_join(data_long_prep, by = c("AllocNR", "DD_join")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(waterstand_WL)) %>%
  # filter(tijpost %in% ref_tijposten) %>%
  mutate(
    DD_num = as.numeric(DD),
    is_target_meting = case_when(
      SalZone == "brak" & round(DD_num, 2) == 0.25 ~ TRUE,
      SalZone == "zoet" & round(DD_num, 2) == 0.35 ~ TRUE,
      round(DD_num, 2) == 0.60 ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE),
    Window_Groep = if_else(DD_num <= 0.45, "DD 25 & 35%", "DD 60%")) %>%
  filter(DD_num >= 0.10 & DD_num <= 0.7)

```


```{r selectie tijposten}

# Lees de tijposten in die behouden moeten blijven
ref_tijposten <- read.csv2(path_ref_lw) %>%
  distinct(tijpost) %>%
  pull(tijpost)

# Filter df_summary_final zodat enkel deze stations overblijven
df_summary_final <- df_summary_final %>%
  filter(tijpost %in% ref_tijposten)

df_yearly_final <- df_yearly_final %>%
  filter(tijpost %in% ref_tijposten)

```


```{r }

rivier_groepen <- list(
  "Zeeschelde" = "Zeeschelde",
  "Durme"      = c("Durme", "Durmemonding"),
  "Rupel & Nete" = c("Nete", "Rupel", "Rupelmonding"),
  "Zenne"      = c("Zenne", "Rupel"),
  "Dijle"      = c("Dijle", "Rupel"))

# Definieer de targets en vensters
df_vergelijking_venster <- df_summary_final %>%
  mutate(
    DD_num = as.numeric(DD),
    # Markeer ALLEEN de specifieke HIC-targets als 'is_target_meting'
    is_target_meting = case_when(
      SalZone == "brak" & round(DD_num, 2) == 0.25 ~ TRUE,
      SalZone == "zoet" & round(DD_num, 2) == 0.35 ~ TRUE,
      round(DD_num, 2) == 0.60 ~ TRUE, # Voor de hoge DD groep
      TRUE ~ FALSE),
    Window_Groep = if_else(DD_num <= 0.45, "DD (25 & 35%)", "DD (60%)")) %>%
  filter(DD_num >= 0.10 & DD_num <= 0.7)

df_vergelijking_venster <- df_vergelijking_venster %>% 
  rbind(., df_vergelijking_venster %>% filter(tijpost == "Hemiksem") %>% mutate(rivier = "Rupel", Dist = -2600)) %>% 
  rbind(., df_vergelijking_venster %>% filter(tijpost == "Temse") %>% mutate(rivier = "Durme", Dist = -3650)) %>% 
  arrange(Dist)

# Maak de jaar-specifieke dataset aan
df_vergelijking_venster_jaar <- df_yearly_final %>%
  mutate(
    DD_num = as.numeric(DD),
    # Markeer de targets (25% brak / 35% zoet / 60% overig)
    is_target_meting = case_when(
      SalZone == "brak" & round(DD_num, 2) == 0.25 ~ TRUE,
      SalZone == "zoet" & round(DD_num, 2) == 0.35 ~ TRUE,
      round(DD_num, 2) == 0.60 ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE),
    Window_Groep = if_else(DD_num <= 0.45, "DD (25 & 35%)", "DD (60%)")) %>%
  filter(DD_num >= 0.10 & DD_num <= 0.7) %>%
  filter(!tijpost %in% c("Wetteren", "Zwijnaarde Afwaarts"))

df_vergelijking_venster_jaar <- df_vergelijking_venster_jaar %>% 
  rbind(., df_vergelijking_venster_jaar %>% filter(tijpost == "Hemiksem") %>% mutate(rivier = "Rupel", Dist = -2600)) %>% 
  rbind(., df_vergelijking_venster_jaar %>% filter(tijpost == "Temse") %>% mutate(rivier = "Durme", Dist = -3650)) %>% 
  arrange(Dist)
```


```{r plot dd}
mijn_venster_plots <- list()

for (naam in names(rivier_groepen)) {
  for (groep in unique(df_vergelijking_venster$Window_Groep)) {
    
    # 1. Filter basisdata
    df_plot <- df_vergelijking_venster %>%
      filter(rivier %in% rivier_groepen[[naam]], Window_Groep == groep)
    
    # --- SPECIFIEKE KALIBRATIE FILTER PER RIVIER ---
    if (grepl("25", groep)) {
      if (naam == "Zeeschelde") {
        # Zeeschelde heeft beide zones: toon het volledige venster  
        df_plot <- df_plot %>% filter((SalZone == "brak" & round(DD_num, 2) %in% c(0.15, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30, 0.35)) |
                                      (SalZone == "zoet" & round(DD_num, 2) %in% c(0.25, 0.30, 0.35, 0.40, 0.45)))
        titel_extra <- "DD25 (brak) / DD35 (zoet)"
        subtitel_extra <- "(25 & 35%)"
      } else {
        # Zijrivieren (Durme, Nete, Dijle, Zenne) zijn zoet: toon enkel 30 & 35
        df_plot <- df_plot %>% filter(round(DD_num, 2) %in% c(0.25, 0.30, 0.35, 0.40, 0.45))
        titel_extra <- "DD35 (zoet)"
        subtitel_extra <- "(35%)"
      }
    } else {
      # Voor de Hoge DD groep (60)
      df_plot <- df_plot %>% filter(round(DD_num, 2) %in% c(0.50, 0.55, 0.60, 0.65, 0.70))
      titel_extra <- "DD60"
      subtitel_extra <- "(60%)"
    }

    # Bereken afstanden en factoren
    df_plot <- df_plot %>%
      mutate(
        Dist_adj = case_when(
          rivier == "Dijle" ~ Dist + 11850,
          rivier == "Nete"  ~ Dist + 11850,
          rivier == "Zenne" ~ Dist + 11850 + 1250,
          TRUE              ~ Dist),
        tijpost = fct_reorder(tijpost, Dist_adj),
        DD_fct = as.factor(round(DD_num * 100, 1)))
    
    if (nrow(df_plot) == 0) next
    
    stations_as <- df_plot %>% distinct(tijpost, Dist_adj) %>% arrange(Dist_adj)
    plot_id <- paste0(naam, "_", gsub("[^0-9]", "", groep))

    # 2. Plot opbouw
    p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = Dist_adj / 1000)) + 
      
      # --- MODEL DATA ---
      geom_line(aes(y = waterstand_WL, color = DD_fct, group = DD_fct), 
                linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_point(aes(y = waterstand_WL, color = DD_fct), 
                 size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
      
      # --- METINGEN (Targets) ---
      geom_line(data = subset(df_plot, is_target_meting == TRUE),
                aes(y = waterstand_HIC), 
                color = "black", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_point(data = subset(df_plot, is_target_meting == TRUE),
                 aes(y = waterstand_HIC), 
                 color = "red", size = 2, shape = 18) +
      
      # --- OPMAAK ---
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = stations_as$Dist_adj / 1000, labels = stations_as$tijpost) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 6)) +
      scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Scaldis DD (%)", option = "D", end = 0.8) + 
      
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(
        title = paste0("Kalibratie ", titel_extra, ": ", naam),
        subtitle = paste0("Blauwgroene punten = Model, Rode punten = HIC-meting DD ", subtitel_extra),
        x = "Meetstation", y = "Waterstand (m TAW)") +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size = 8),
        legend.position = "right",
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.2))

    if (grepl("Zeeschelde", naam)) {

    p <- p + geom_vline(
      xintercept = 29, 
      linetype   = "dashed", 
      color      = "red3", 
      linewidth  = 0.8, 
      alpha      = 0.6) +
    annotate(
      "text", 
      x = 29, 
      y = 5, 
      label = "Brak <<       >> Zoet", 
      angle = 0, 
      vjust = 1.2,   # Tekst iets laten zakken zodat hij niet wordt afgekapt
      hjust = 0.5, 
      color = "red3", 
      size = 2.8,    # Iets kleinere tekst
      fontface = "bold")
  }
    print(p)
    mijn_venster_plots[[plot_id]] <- p
  }
}
```


```{r plot dd per jaar}
mijn_venster_plots_jaar <- list()

for (naam in names(rivier_groepen)) {
  for (groep in unique(df_vergelijking_venster_jaar$Window_Groep)) {
    
    # 1. Filter en bereken afstand
    df_plot <- df_vergelijking_venster_jaar %>%
      filter(rivier %in% rivier_groepen[[naam]], Window_Groep == groep) %>%
      mutate(
        Dist_adj = case_when(
          rivier == "Dijle" ~ Dist + 11850,
          rivier == "Nete"  ~ Dist + 11850,
          rivier == "Zenne" ~ Dist + 11850 + 1250,
          TRUE              ~ Dist 
        ),
        tijpost = fct_reorder(tijpost, Dist_adj),
        DD_fct = as.factor(round(DD_num * 100, 1)))
    
    if (nrow(df_plot) == 0) next
    
    # --- NIEUW: Bereken y_max voor de annotatie ---
    y_max <- max(c(df_plot$waterstand_WL, df_plot$waterstand_HIC), na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Dynamische titel-extra bepalen
    titel_extra <- if (grepl("25", groep)) "DD25 (brak) / DD35 (zoet)" else "DD60"
    
    stations_as <- df_plot %>% distinct(tijpost, Dist_adj) %>% arrange(Dist_adj)
    plot_id <- paste0(naam, "_", gsub("[^0-9]", "", groep))

    # 2. Plot opbouw met Faceting
    p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = Dist_adj / 1000)) + 
      
      # --- MODEL DATA ---
      geom_line(aes(y = waterstand_WL, color = DD_fct, group = DD_fct), 
                linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
      geom_point(aes(y = waterstand_WL, color = DD_fct), 
                 size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
      
      # --- METINGEN ---
      geom_line(data = subset(df_plot, is_target_meting == TRUE),
                aes(y = waterstand_HIC), 
                color = "black", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_point(data = subset(df_plot, is_target_meting == TRUE),
                 aes(y = waterstand_HIC), 
                 color = "red", size = 1.5, shape = 18) +
      
      facet_wrap(~jaar, ncol = 2) + 
      
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = stations_as$Dist_adj / 1000, labels = stations_as$tijpost) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 6)) +
      scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Scaldis DD (%)", option = "D", end = 0.8) + 
      
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(
        title = paste0("Kalibratie ", titel_extra, " per jaar: ", naam),
        subtitle = paste0("Blauwgroene punten = Scaldis-model, Rode ruiten = HIC-meting ", groep),
        x = "Meetstation", y = "Waterstand (m TAW)") +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size = 8),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.2)) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1))

    # Verticale lijn voor Zeeschelde
    if (grepl("Zeeschelde", naam)) {
      # # We bepalen het punt voor de tekst op 95% van het maximum om afkapping te voorkomen
      # y_pos <- max(c(df_plot$waterstand_WL, df_plot$waterstand_HIC), na.rm = TRUE) * 0.95
      
      p <- p + geom_vline(
        xintercept = 29, 
        linetype   = "dashed", 
        color      = "red3", 
        linewidth  = 0.8, 
        alpha      = 0.6) +
      annotate(
        "text", 
        x = 29, 
        y = 5, 
        label = "Brak <<       >> Zoet", 
        angle = 0, 
        vjust = 1.2,   # Laat de tekst zakken
        hjust = 0.5, 
        color = "red3", 
        size = 2.8,    # Iets kleiner gemaakt
        fontface = "bold")
    }
    
    print(p)
    mijn_venster_plots_jaar[[plot_id]] <- p
  }
}
```

